=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line: 1209 (post_tracking_comment) and 5152 (post_issue_comment_json)
  Problem: `body_bytes` is captured with `wc -c | tr -d '[:space:]'`. No guard exists in the tracking-comment path before the `-gt 65536` integer test.
  Why: A locale/POSIX-mismatch or pipe error can make `wc` emit non-numeric output, producing "integer expression expected" and aborting the orchestrator poll cycle (hard failure instead of fail-open).
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line: ~5135 (validation_history_gate_decision_for_current_sha)
  Problem: The JSON filter for `is_fail` treats any later `error` / `errored` outcome (or `raw_conclusion=failure`) as blocking even when the failure is not a harness defect.
  Why: A successful fix-up that leaves a later non-harness `error` entry will still block eager final-PR promotion even after the tracking issue reaches `ai:ready-to-merge`.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line: ~7033 (mark_validation_failed) / ~5960 (harness_error short-circuit)
  Problem: `harness_error` is correctly detected and logged, but the judge prompts (mode-judge.txt:18-27 and mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt:16-25) still treat any `validation-failed` label as evidence of application regression unless the label `ai:harness-broken` is also present.
  Why: The judge may penalize the project for an infrastructure defect.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line: ~12012 (revalidate dedup window)
  Problem: The 5-minute actor+SHA deduplication for `/revalidate` relies on AI-memory `revalidate_events` reads that are fail-open.
  Why: A transient memory-branch outage silently drops the dedup check, so rapid repeated `/revalidate` comments can re-dispatch the same validation run and leave duplicate `revalidate_event.v1` records.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: agents.md
  Line: 197-209 (stable log prefixes)
  Problem: New prefixes (`EAGER_DRAFT_PR_*`, `INTEGRATION_STALE_ALERT_SENT`, `HARNESS_ERROR_DETECTED`, `FORCE_MERGE_BYPASS`, `BACKPRESSURE_*`) were added but the workflow-log-analysis and drift-audit tooling that hard-codes the old list will miss them until the next `@stable` cut.
  Why: Reports lose visibility of the new resilience events, violating the "stable log prefixes" contract.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "A dedicated node-runtime validation family shipped under workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/ with the fixture/docs/tests needed for non-Hardhat Node consumers and finalized JSON-based custom/skip test controls" (AC1 fro
